graph: F_r = K_1 join (r disjoint copies of K_2)
model: Proper coloring; deterministic vertex-specific local functions; simultaneous one-color guesses; at least one correct guess.
lookup_convention: A table is indexed by the nonzero difference d = other_leaf_color - hub_color, with entries for d=1,...,q-1. An unscaled leaf guesses hub_color + table[d-1] modulo q. At scale s modulo 7 it guesses hub_color + s*base_table[(s_inverse*d mod 7)-1] modulo 7.
hub_rule: For the observed leaf colors, calculate all hub colors making the coloring proper and every leaf guess wrong. If this set is a singleton, guess it. If it is empty, choose any color (preferably unseen at leaves). The certificates prove that it never has more than one element for a proper outer view.
